text:
maria: Quick proposal — add a /deploy template + change-window safety checks to reduce noisy rollbacks. Details and flag suggestions below.

jordan: +1. Can we standardize flags? e.g., --pin <version>, --canary <percent>, --window <start/end>, --dry-run. Also a template generator for release notes.

alex: Oncall concern: bot needs to auto-check team change windows from calendar. If outside window require --force and 2 approvals :eyes:.

samir: Prototype command examples:
```
/deploy service=redwood-api version=2026-03-15-rc3 --pin --canary=10 --window=2026-03-16T01:00Z/2026-03-16T05:00Z
```
Also a minimal release template we can auto-populate:
```
summary: one-line description
risk: low|medium|high
rollback-plan: steps to rollback and threshold
owner: @owner
notes: optional
```

deploy-bot: New command registered: `/deploy template create` — creates RFC-style release template. Example: `/deploy template create --name "canary-small" --fields summary,risk,rollback,owner`. Templates stored in /deploy/templates.

maria: Can deploy-bot run a preflight: lint config, verify pinned images, check for KV/migration diffs? If any check fails, block the deploy and report back.

deploy-bot: Added preflight hooks: lint, image-check, migration-check. Admins can bypass with `--skip-preflight`. Dry-run available: `/deploy --dry-run ...` returns plan and checks.

oncall-bot: Calendar check: team 'payments' change-windows: Mon-Fri 01:00-06:00 UTC. Outside that window, deploy requires 2 approvals from APPROVERS list. Use `--force` only with overrides.

alex: Rollback heuristics idea: auto-rollback if 5xx rate increases by >2% (absolute) sustained for >3m OR p95 latency increases >200ms AND error budget >50% consumed. Manual rollback should be easy to trigger: `/deploy rollback <service> <last-good-version>`.

samir: Suggest extended command flag: `--rollback-threshold=5xx:2%,p95:200ms,window:3m`. Bot can parse it and attach to the release metadata.

jordan: I'll add a CI check that runs `deploy-bot dry-run` for any PR touching infra/deploy templates and fails the PR if dry-run errors.

maria: OK next steps: jordan opens PR for flags + CI job, samir wires preflight hooks into runtime checks, alex updates oncall calendar rules and publishes approvers list. We'll schedule a staging run next Wednesday for smoke tests.

alex: Sounds good — I'll post timings in #eng-oncall and ping SRE when staging starts.

samir: Also will prepare a short demo GIF for the docs :grin:.

maria: Thanks team :tada: — once staging looks good we can flip this on for low-risk services by Friday.
